1	export type RateLimiterMode = 'fixed' | 'sliding'
2	
3	export interface RateLimiterOptions {
4	  max: number
5	  windowMs: number
6	  mode: RateLimiterMode
7	  now?: () => number
8	}
9	
10	interface FixedBucket {
11	  windowStart: number
12	  count: number
13	}
14	
15	export class RateLimiter {
16	  private readonly max: number
17	  private readonly windowMs: number
18	  private readonly mode: RateLimiterMode
19	  private readonly now: () => number
20	  private readonly fixedBuckets = new Map<string, FixedBucket>()
21	  private readonly slidingTimestamps = new Map<string, number[]>()
22	
23	  constructor(options: RateLimiterOptions) {
24	    this.max = options.max
25	    this.windowMs = options.windowMs
26	    this.mode = options.mode
27	    this.now = options.now ?? (() => Date.now())
28	  }
29	
30	  allow(key: string): boolean {
31	    const t = this.now()
32	    return this.mode === 'fixed' ? this.allowFixed(key, t) : this.allowSliding(key, t)
33	  }
34	
35	  private allowFixed(key: string, t: number): boolean {
36	    const windowStart = Math.floor(t / this.windowMs) * this.windowMs
37	    const bucket = this.fixedBuckets.get(key)
38	    if (!bucket || bucket.windowStart !== windowStart) {
39	      this.fixedBuckets.set(key, { windowStart, count: 1 })
40	      return true
41	    }
42	    if (bucket.count >= this.max) return false
43	    bucket.count += 1
44	    return true
45	  }
46	
47	  private allowSliding(key: string, t: number): boolean {
48	    const cutoff = t - this.windowMs
49	    let timestamps = this.slidingTimestamps.get(key)
50	    if (!timestamps) {
51	      timestamps = []
52	      this.slidingTimestamps.set(key, timestamps)
53	    }
54	    let drop = 0
55	    while (drop < timestamps.length && timestamps[drop]! <= cutoff) drop += 1
56	    if (drop > 0) timestamps.splice(0, drop)
57	    if (timestamps.length >= this.max) return false
58	    timestamps.push(t)
59	    return true
60	  }
61	}

1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/RateLimiter.js'
3	
4	function makeClock(start = 1_000_000): { now: () => number; advance: (ms: number) => void; set: (t: number) => void } {
5	  let t = start
6	  return {
7	    now: () => t,
8	    advance: (ms: number) => { t += ms },
9	    set: (next: number) => { t = next },
10	  }
11	}
12	
13	describe('RateLimiter — fixed mode', () => {
14	  it('allows up to max within a window and blocks the next call', () => {
15	    const clock = makeClock()
16	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
17	
18	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
19	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
20	    }
21	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
22	  })
23	
24	  it('resets capacity at the next window boundary', () => {
25	    const clock = makeClock(1_000_000)
26	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
27	
28	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
29	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
30	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
31	
32	    // jump into the next discrete window
33	    clock.set(1_001_000)
34	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
35	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
36	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
37	  })
38	
39	  it('tracks multiple keys independently', () => {
40	    const clock = makeClock()
41	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
42	
43	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
44	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
45	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
46	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(false)
47	  })
48	
49	  it('does NOT reset purely on elapsed-time since first call (window-aligned semantics)', () => {
50	    // Pick a start near a window boundary to verify discrete-window behavior.
51	    const clock = makeClock(999) // window [0, 1000)
52	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
53	
54	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // first call at t=999, in window [0, 1000)
55	    clock.set(1000) // next window starts
56	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // new window allows again
57	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
58	  })
59	})
60	
61	describe('RateLimiter — sliding mode', () => {
62	  it('allows up to max in trailing window and blocks excess', () => {
63	    const clock = makeClock(0)
64	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
65	
66	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
67	      expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true)
68	    }
69	    clock.set(500)
70	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(false)
71	  })
72	
73	  it('allows once the oldest call ages out', () => {
74	    const clock = makeClock(0)
75	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
76	
77	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
78	      expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true) // t=0
79	    }
80	    clock.set(500)
81	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(false)
82	    clock.set(1100) // first call at t=0 has aged out (cutoff = 100)
83	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true)
84	  })
85	
86	  it('tracks multiple keys independently', () => {
87	    const clock = makeClock(0)
88	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
89	
90	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
91	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
92	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
93	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(false)
94	  })
95	
96	  it('only ages out calls that are strictly older than windowMs', () => {
97	    const clock = makeClock(0)
98	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
99	
100	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // t=0
101	    clock.set(500)
102	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // t=500
103	    clock.set(1000) // cutoff = 0; t=0 is not strictly newer than cutoff
104	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // t=0 ages out; now have [500, 1000]
105	    clock.set(1499)
106	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false) // still 2 in trailing 1000ms
107	    clock.set(1501)
108	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true) // t=500 ages out
109	  })
110	})

115	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
